test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The proposal was more superior (1)/ to the earlier draft (2)/ because of improved organization (3)/ and clarity. (4)/
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the usage of the phrase **"more superior".**
 
• The word **"superior"** is already a comparative adjective, so the use of "more" before it is redundant and incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should simply be **"The proposal was superior"** without using "more."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The proposal was superior to the earlier draft because of improved organization and clarity."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2: "than the earlier draft"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "because of improved organization"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "and clarity"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
